scope: One bounded client-only optimization: begin review editor module loading at the same time as its selected, live-authorized rounds GET. Keep Settings module boundaries and all request/draft ownership unchanged. Separate instrumentation investigates remaining identity waits.
hypothesis: On selecting Anonymous Review, overlap review code download with rounds GET instead of starting code only after data settles. Preserve inactive-feature bundle savings. No effect expected on warm editor visits, request count, bytes or server execution.
constraints: No authorization/data caching, authority event suppression, identity/session/policy/query change, schema/index/infra/dependency change or publication. All previous font/scope fixes retained.
profiles: 80ms latency, 200000 B/s down, 93750 B/s up, CPU4x

deferredFeatureCost.readiness: Settings actual public-profile form, fixture meeting data, empty scheduled list after fetch, and anonymous-review controls. Anonymous review uses its existing Settings/Application link; warm return uses browser history. Decisions group/details summary open before timed action.

pilot: Two excluded eight-outcome development feature probes, plus the unchanged new browser test failing on baseline and passing on candidate. Pilots do not enter primary quantiles. A separate local GET verifies the instrumented observer before collection.
primaryMetric: Full preceding source document useful-content time plus captured requests/script/body bytes and separate subsequent click timing. No readiness clock change. Bounded drains, incomplete background transport flags, fonts/FCP/CLS retained.
power: User-confirmed open lid and idle host. Earlier authorization permits battery. Record one initial power source and low-power mode0 throughout each whole profile; temporary awake assertion and actual sleep audit. No rows replaced for timing.
publication: No push, PR, merge or deployment. Report causal limits and inherited Settings/review first-use risks.
candidate: Frozen Phase14 build with the exact CANDIDATE_SOURCE.json hashes; one application file differs from the Phase13 baseline.

hostControl.existingDevServerPort3111: Unrelated services remain untouched; any observed foreign dev worker must stay within the declared idle CPU bound.
invalidateWholeProfileIf: foreign build/test runner observed during measurement
foreign Next dev CPU grows more than1 CPU-second in any60-second window
original checkout HEAD or porcelain status changes
Recorded initial power source changes within a profile, or low-power mode differs from0
hostControl.failurePolicy: Stop or retain whole profile as invalid; never replace individual slow rows. Diagnostics are separate from timing samples.
hostControl.baseline: Each complete profile records the original checkout state immediately before its first sample. Changes during preparation are recorded and preserved; any later change within that profile invalidates it.

diagnostics.scope: Separate instrumented native and browser probes using the Phase13 observer, excluded from primary timings. No telemetry shipped to production.
diagnostics.browserPaths: Existing deferred-screens Settings/Meetings/Decisions/Review workload, cold and warm; separate from primary.

interpretationRule: Claim a target performance gain only where the complete matched cold useful-content p50/p95 improve under valid controls. Report unchanged/worse metrics regardless of proven download overlap. No broad latency claim from structural overlap; small n nearest-rank p95 often equals maximum.
